verdict.rationale: Fivetran's own sync modes (Soft Delete, Live, History) and its capture-deletes feature control how deleted source records are kept or removed in the destination. Data blocking and row filtering keep unwanted data from being synced at all. These are real product controls over deletion and history in the pipeline, but the evidence is mostly feature-name listings with no detail. Missing for 10: documentation of Fivetran-side data retention periods or retention policy settings, explicit user-initiated deletion or purge controls for synced or stored data, in-depth docs on how each sync mode handles retention, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
